title: Joint iron–inflammation encoding does not establish incremental red-cell distribution width prediction across NHANES cycles
abstract: A log serum-iron × log CRP interaction did not establish incremental RDW prediction beyond flexible individual biomarkers, Hb, MCV and conventional covariates in exploratory NHANES2007–2008 to2009–2010 transfer (4,824 source; 5,184 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.001541 RDW-percent² (-0.192%), jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.007778,0.004291].
